title: The Long Weekend — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 100bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal life philosophy Spanish French language learning Perth weekend
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The long weekend is three days and it happens about eight times a year
And every long weekend the same psychology appears
You plan too much for Friday and the Friday gets away
And Saturday is recovery and Sunday is the day

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
El fin de semana largo es tres días y ocurre ocho veces al año
[The long weekend is three days and it happens eight times a year]
Y cada fin de semana largo aparece el mismo engaño
[And every long weekend the same deception appears]
Planeas demasiado el viernes y el viernes se escapa
[You plan too much for Friday and the Friday gets away]
Y el sábado es recuperación y el domingo destapa
[And Saturday is recovery and Sunday uncovers]

[Chorus — English]
The long weekend knows something I don't know
It knows that three days is exactly one day more than the flow
The long weekend is the pressure valve the working week has bought
That's my boy

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
Le long weekend est trois jours et il arrive huit fois par an
[The long weekend is three days and it happens eight times a year]
Et chaque long weekend la même psychologie est au-devant
[And every long weekend the same psychology is upfront]
Tu planifies trop le vendredi et le vendredi part sans toi
[You plan too much for Friday and the Friday leaves without you]
Et le samedi est la récupération — le dimanche est pour toi
[And Saturday is recovery — Sunday is for you]

[Outro — All three languages]
Long weekend knows… El fin de semana largo sabe… Le long weekend sait
Three days, exactly enough — Tres días, exactamente suficiente — Trois jours, exactement assez
That's my boy
